name: The Relay
tagline: An analog signal-sorting mystery for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
description: A decommissioned coastal signal relay station. Old analog transmissions come in, and it's your job to sort them into the right archive channels — until the story hidden inside the static starts to piece itself together. Free to start, with a single premium unlock for the full Archive.

name: Running Plan
tagline: Turn a markdown training plan into adaptive watch workouts.
description: Upload a training plan — half marathon, marathon, whatever your coach wrote up — as a markdown file. On-device intelligence turns it into HealthKit workouts on iPhone and Apple Watch, then adapts the plan as it learns from your heart rate, pace, and how each run actually went.

name: Supplement Tracker
tagline: A widget-first way to stay on top of supplements and meds.
description: A supplement and medication tracker built around interactive widgets rather than a clinical checklist. Smart scheduling handles things like cycles and take-with-food rules, with streaks to keep you consistent.

name: Rear-Approach Safety
tagline: Back Tap your phone to check what's behind you on a run.
description: Double or triple Back Tap while you're running, and the front camera checks the road behind you — no chest mount required. The whole screen goes green, yellow, or red depending on whether something's approaching and how fast.
